critical_code_review_comments: Fix at TradeChart.jsx L194-223 is correct: maxRightOffsetPx = paneW - wrapperW/2 (distance from newest to right of plot when newest sits at 50% of wrapper), converted to bars via visible/paneW. Formula is mathematically equivalent to placing newest at wrapperW/2 pixels from the wrapper's left edge, since the plot area starts at wrapper's left edge (price axis is on the right).
clampingRef.v guard + requestAnimationFrame reset correctly prevent infinite recursion when setVisibleLogicalRange re-fires onRange.
Uses wrapRef.current?.clientWidth with fallback to paneW — safe against ref being null during unmount.

Minor: on mobile the natural rightOffset:8 cap means newest cannot drop below ~69% of wrapper via user pan — the clamp is effectively defensive-only on mobile. Not a bug; just noting the code path is only exercised on wider viewports (desktop/tablet).
Older-history lazy-load (range.from < 15) triggers before the clamp check — good ordering; clamp only fires on right-panning, load fires on left-panning, so no conflict.
Consider bumping the '< 15' lazy-load threshold to a percentage of visible so it scales with barSpacing/paneW rather than being a fixed magic number (not blocking).
